process.title: A process designed so you don't have to think about it.
process.step1Body: An honest conversation about your business, what hurts and what you want to achieve. No jargon.
process.step2Body: Clear scope, realistic timing, transparent investment. Decisions made with data, not smoke.
process.step3Body: Short iterations, full visibility, continuous releases. We work with your team, not locked away.
process.step4Body: When we launch, we stay with you. Support, evolution, metrics. We don't disappear after signing.
